display_long_description:
The apocalypse has begun, and the world is crawling with the undead.
In Zombie Elimnator, you are one of the few survivors left standing. Armed with basic weapons and your instincts, you must fight through endless waves of zombies coming from every direction.

This is a straightforward, action-packed VR experience focused purely on shooting, aiming, and survival. No upgrades, no fancy gear — just you, your weapon, and the horror closing in.

Perfect for players who love simple, fast-paced zombie action with immersive VR combat.

Key Features:
- Pure Shooting Gameplay: No menus, no upgrades — just nonstop action.
- Immersive VR Combat: Feel the tension of close-range zombie encounters.
- Varied Environments: Face the undead in dark alleys, ruined streets, and foggy graveyards.
- Simple Controls: Easy to learn, hard to survive.
- Endless Survival Mode: How long can you last before the horde gets you?
